description: This repository's own updates, on top of the shared preset KevinDeBenedetti/renovate-config (Monday-morning schedule, best practices, SHA-pinned actions and images, 3-day soak, OSV security updates, labels). Replaces Dependabot: every update of the week, majors included, lands in one pull request.

customManagers.description: The uv version the CI installs (`version:` of astral-sh/setup-uv in lint.yaml and test.yaml), marked with `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` on the line above: the github-actions manager only reads `uses:` refs, so without it the CI's uv would drift from the one in apps/server/Dockerfile.

packageRules.description: Renovate gets a release date from Docker Hub only: the ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv image of the Dockerfile would never pass the preset's soak.

One pull request for everything (branch renovate/all-dependencies): the preset's weekly non-major group, widened to majors, so a week's updates run CI once and are reviewed together. separateMajorMinor and separateMultipleMajor are off above, or the majors would still get a branch of their own. A major gets the preset's `major` label on the group PR; one failing update holds the whole group: exclude it from the Dependency Dashboard, or give it `"groupName": null`.
The Python runtime moves on purpose, with the CI's PYTHON_VERSION and requires-python in apps/server/pyproject.toml, not in the weekly batch: the python image gets patches and digests only.
